working_definition: Author cell type 'T neuron T4/T5c-d' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 734 cells): T4/T5 neurons of subtypes c and d (lobula plate layers 3 and 4); authors' terms T4c, T4d, T5c, T5d.
searches_performed: ancestors of T4/T5 subtypes via EBI OLS4

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe that has its cell body in the posterior part of the optic lobe and a cell body fiber that bifurcates in the second optic chiasma (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: Grouped call spanning T4c, T4d, T5c, T5d. T4 and T5 are siblings under T neuron and no intermediate class groups c/d subtypes, so T neuron is the most specific common parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3.
T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4.
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3.
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4.

recommendation: Broad match to T neuron; four members listed.
